  - text: CLASS 11 · RELATIONS AND FUNCTIONS
  - heading "Equivalence Relations" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Build a relation on a set and test whether it is an equivalence relation.
  - strong: Equivalence relation = Reflexive + Symmetric + Transitive
  - navigation: 18 min ADVANCED CONCEPT interactive lab
  - complementary:
    - img
    - paragraph: "Equivalence classes are disjoint and cover the set. • Disjoint: No two classes share an element. • Cover: Every element is in exactly one class."
    - button "Reset lab":
      - img
      - text: Reset lab

      - heading "1 RELATION GRAPH (edit)" [level=2]:
        - text: 1 RELATION GRAPH
        - emphasis: (edit)
      - paragraph: Click two nodes to toggle a pair (add/remove).
      - text: ◯ Self-loop (a,a) ⟶ Pair (a,b)

        - text: 2 RELATION MATRIX

      - text: "|S| = 6 Total pairs = 14"
      - paragraph: 1 = related 0 = not related
    - article:
      - heading "3 LIVE PROPERTY GATES" [level=2]
      - paragraph: All gates must be green.
      - article:
        - img
        - text: Reflexive
        - paragraph: (a,a) is in R for every a ∈ S.
        - strong: PASS
      - article:
        - img
        - text: Symmetric
        - paragraph: If (a,b) ∈ R then (b,a) ∈ R.
        - strong: PASS
      - article:
        - img
        - text: Transitive
        - paragraph: If (a,b) and (b,c) are in R then (a,c) is in R.
        - strong: PASS
      - complementary:
        - img
        - text: All gates passed! R is an equivalence relation.
    - article:
      - heading "4 EQUIVALENCE CLASSES (partition)" [level=2]:
        - text: 4 EQUIVALENCE CLASSES
        - emphasis: (partition)
      - paragraph: Elements are grouped into equivalence classes.
      - strong: "[a] = { a, b, c }"
      - text: "Size: 3 Class 1"
      - strong: "[d] = { d, e }"
      - text: "Size: 2 Class 2"
      - strong: "[f] = { f }"
      - text: "Size: 1 Class 3"
      - heading "PARTITION CHECK" [level=3]
      - paragraph: ✓ Classes are pairwise disjoint.
      - paragraph: ✓ Classes cover the entire set S.
      - strong: ✓ VALID PARTITION
  - heading "TRY IT" [level=3]
